You need a GPU only when a model runs on your own hardware.

Calling a hosted API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) needs none. Embeddings and retrieval for RAG through an API need none either, because the vector search runs on CPU in Postgres. Image and video generation through a hosted API also need no GPU.
